text: The Goa (Recovery of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty, Other Dues through Settlement) Act, 2023 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202334 Act Number: 34 Enactment Date: 2023-08-07 Act Year: 2023 Short Title: The Goa (Recovery of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty, Other Dues through Settlement) Act, 2023 Long Title: To provide for the expeditious enforcement of payment of arrears of tax, penalty and/or interest in respect of the period of assessment up to the 30th day of June, 2017 under the Central Sales Tax Act, 1956 (Central Act 74 of 1956), the Goa Entertainment Tax Act, 1964 (Act 2 of 1964), the Goa Sales Tax Act, 1964 (Act 4 of 1964), the Goa Tax on Luxuries Act, 1988 (Act 17 of 1988), the Goa Tax on Entry of Goods Act, 2000 (Act 14 of 2000) and the Goa Value Added Tax Act, 2005 (Act 9 of 2005), by way of settlement and matters connected therewith.
